points: PalletPoseNode::on_pair is the pose-process entry. extract_detection_candidates walks the Detection2DArray once, keeps the highest-scoring hypothesis per detection, and stores source_index as that detection's slot (skipped non-matches leave gaps). select_detection (default highest_confidence) is one std::max_element: score, then area_px; a full tie keeps the earlier candidate because max_element returns the first maximum. largest_area swaps that key order. An unknown strategy throws. The chosen DetectionCandidate is copied out by value; the other class-matched candidates stay in the local vector through publish_pose and publish_failure_diagnostics, then are destroyed. estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 runs once, and only that source_index is stored as PoseResult.instance_id or FailureResult.instance_id. publish_pose writes PalletPoseStamped with yaw, face normal, plane_inlier_ratio, n_face_points, chamfer_cost_m, and this pair's stamps, and no source-index fields. publish_ok_diagnostics emits chamfer_cost_m, plane_inlier_ratio, n_face_points, input_rgb_stamp, and input_depth_stamp. On estimate failure the only publish is publish_failure_diagnostics (failure_reason plus those two stamps). Two early returns publish nothing: an empty candidate list, and a depth_image_to_meters exception. There is no subset split. Ranking the leftover candidates is linear in the detection count; detector postprocess caps max_detections at 10. Calling estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 once per extra detection would repeat the chamfer grids below.

Measured stage-2 time is that single estimate. two_stage_chamfer_search_v2 always runs. The grid loop is v = -search; v <= search + 0.5*step; v += step. Default free coarse is 21 yaw by 31 by 31 = 20181 (±10 deg at 1 deg, ±0.15 m at 0.01 m); free fine is 13 by 25 by 25 = 8125 (±1.2 deg at 0.2 deg, ±0.012 m at 0.001 m). two_stage_chamfer_search_v2_with_prior runs unless lambda_eff <= lambda_floor 0.05. confidence is clamp((0.020 - free_cost) / 0.014, 0, 1) and lambda_eff is prior_lambda 3.0 times (1 - confidence), so the prior is skipped only when free_cost is at or below 0.020 - 0.014 * (1 - 0.05/3) = 0.006233... m. The prior search is centered on the PCA init_pose, not on free_pose. Prior coarse is 21 by 21 by 21 = 9261 (±0.10 m at 0.01 m, same 21 yaw steps) plus another 8125 fine evaluations. The four grids are 45692 evaluations. Each of those four stage searches also calls chamfer_cost_v2 on its seed before the parallel loop, and the zero-offset cell is inside the grid, so that seed is a second evaluation. choose_pi_ambiguous_pose adds two full costs, the anchor chamfer_cost_v2 always runs (it is before the lambda_eff branch), and a successful prior path adds one more data-only chamfer_cost_v2. The common frame is 45700 chamfer_cost_from_rotated evaluations. OpenMP schedule(static) does not reduce that count; the critical section runs once per thread after the loop.

Each of those evaluations is O(N log N) with N=182. cached_prototype builds the default contour once and rebuilds it only when shape parameters change: outer 1.20 by 0.14 m is 94 samples and two 0.47 by 0.10 m pockets are 44 each, at contour_spacing_m 0.03, using n = max(2, ceil(length/spacing)+1) per edge with the endpoint omitted. rotate_proto_into writes the N by 2 rotation into thread-local ChamferTls.rotated once per theta, and proto * R.transpose() materializes a temporary only when theta changes. chamfer_cost_from_rotated still assigns tls.translated = rotated and adds (tx, ty) on every pose, bilinear-samples all N distances, assign-copies all N into tls.sorted, and std::sorts the whole vector even though trim_fraction 0.10 sums only ceil(0.9*N) = 164. sample_bilinear_into setConstant-fills the distance buffer before the loop. The bilinear reads are Eigen column-major points(i, 0) and points(i, 1), a stride of N doubles. At 45700 evaluations the translation copy is 133078400 bytes and the sort copy is 66539200 bytes, before the sort itself.

Before the grid, once per posed detection: rasterize_points_to_mask uses resolution_m 0.005 and padding_m 0.80. When the plane-inlier span is the nominal 1.20 m by 0.14 m face, the padded x span is 2.8 m so width is ceil(2.8/0.005)+1 = 561, and the padded y span is 1.7400000000000002 m so ceil(span/0.005) is 349 and height is 350, about 196350 pixels. close_mask clones that mask, runs an elliptical MORPH_CLOSE (kernel 5, close_radius_px 2), then connectedComponentsWithStats and a second full-frame mask. extract_boundary_mask erodes and builds another edge image. compute_distance_transform_v2 builds a uint8 image and calls cv::distanceTransform with DIST_L2 and DIST_MASK_PRECISE, then convertTo a CV_32FC1 distance image. That OpenCV imgproc work is the large non-search dependency inside stage 2 and is rebuilt every frame; the prototype cache does not reuse the distance image. It is still smaller than the 45692-evaluation grid.

sample_face_points scans every depth pixel, O(Hd*Wd). Vendored camera.yaml is depth 640 by 480 and RGB 1920 by 1080, so each posed detection walks 307200 pixels: a K_inv ray, an SE3 into RGB, a pinhole project, and only then a lookup in the full RGB mask. build_bbox_mask first zero-fills that 1920 by 1080 CV_8UC1 and erodes the whole image erode_px 2 times with a 3 by 3 kernel, even though only the bbox rectangle is set. Accepted points go into per-thread std::vector<Eigen::Vector3d> buckets that together reserve Hd*Wd/4 (76800 Vector3d, about 1.8 MB) regardless of bbox size, then are copied again, one row at a time, into an N by 3 Eigen::MatrixXd. depth_image_to_meters convertTo-copies the whole depth frame into a new CV_32FC1 once per synced pair (16UC1 scaled by depth_scale 0.001), before the single estimate, so that copy does not multiply with extra detections.

ransac_plane_fit runs up to ransac_iters 100 and stops early only at inlier ratio 0.85. Every iteration allocates a residual ArrayXd and a bool mask over all face points; the winning inliers are copied into a fresh matrix for Eigen::JacobiSVD, which centres another copy. estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 then calls plane_inlier_mask, which allocates those arrays again, and copies the inliers a second time into plane_points_3d. project_points_to_plane_2d allocates both a relative N by 3 matrix and an N by 2 result. estimate_pca_long_axis allocates another centred copy of the 2D inliers. Those passes are linear in the face-point count and sit under the chamfer grid. They run only for the one candidate select_detection already chose.

Stage 1 is a separate process and is not where unused source indexes are published. rtdetr_detector_node defaults to backend mock, which skips inference copies. full_pipeline.launch.py loads detector.yaml with backend tensorrt, input_size 640, and max_detections 10. On that path image_to_rgb copies msg.data via bytes() (about 6.2 MB for 1920 by 1080 rgb8) and ascontiguousarray, and bgr8 reverses channels into a second array. preprocess resizes to 640 by 640 and builds a float32 CHW array (1 by 3 by 640 by 640, about 4.9 MB). TensorRTBackend.infer astype-copies both inputs, np.copyto into pagelocked host memory, memcpy HtoD, execute_async_v3, memcpy DtoH, then .copy() of labels, boxes, and scores. postprocess is a score threshold and an argsort capped at max_detections 10, with no NMS. tensorrt plus pycuda dominate stage 1; the pose process still pays the chamfer grids after message_filters ApproximateTime (queue 10, slop 0.1 s) delivers the pair.

geometry_core links Eigen3 dynamic matrices, OpenCV core and imgproc, yaml-cpp, and OpenMP, compiled -O3. yaml-cpp loads the camera model only in the node constructor, not per frame. message_filters only gates the pair. Writing the source indexes already stored on the candidate vector onto PalletPoseStamped, or the same integers onto the existing failure DiagnosticStatus, is a few integers outside the 45692-evaluation loop.
